title: Heat exchangers.
officialText:
Shutoff valves shall be installed on the supply and return side of a heat exchanger.
Exception: Shutoff valves shall not be required when heat exchangers are integral with a boiler; or are a component of a
manufacturer’s boiler and heat exchanger packaged unit and are capable of being isolated from the hydronic system by the
supply and return valves required by Section 1005.1.
